messages:
maria_fin: Heads up — reseller invoice INV-4721 (Azure) shows a sudden downgrade to S0 pricing for May even though partner had a committed tier for May (S2). Amounts don't match the commitment credits. Can someone pull the marketplace settlement lines?
liam_rev: that sounds like the commitment-tier mapping bug we saw in March. @oscar_az can you check the allocation id?
oscar_az: pulling now. Partner id: rr-partner-113. Subscription: az-sub-4411. Settlement export shows settlement_line SL-7788 billed at S0 rates for 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31. Commitment record CR-221 still active per our booking system.
sara_ops: weird — did the partner change SKUs? If they changed plan code we can lose the commitment link. Any seller notes?
maria_fin: partner says no SKU change. They submitted a change request on Apr 28 to increase seats, not to downgrade tier.
billing-bot: Automated check: Commitment CR-221 linked to alloc-221-az matches subscription az-sub-4411. No SKU change events in marketplace audit from Apr 25-30. Potential cause: settlement mapping rule rule-az-tier-match failed for S2->S0 due to missing ratecard id.
liam_rev: ok this is likely a ratecard mismatch during ratecard refresh. If marketplace uses an old ratecard id we get default S0. We need to request an adjustment and retroactive commitment credit for May.
oscar_az: I'll open a vendor reconciliation ticket with Azure support. Draft: "Settlement lines SL-7788 for partner rr-partner-113 billed at S0 but commitment CR-221 should apply (S2). Please reprocess settlement or issue credit for delta ($4,320). Attached: settlement CSV, commitment record screenshot, invoice INV-4721." Approve?
maria_fin: approve. Add GL reference: COMMIT-CR-2026-MAY. Also request an interim hold on revenue recognition for $4,320.
sara_ops: also request the Azure support include a corrected ratecard id in the reprocessed settlement to prevent recurrence, and ask for their internal incident id so eng can patch rule-az-tier-match.
oscar_az: submitted ticket AZ-SUP-2026-9912, escalation requested. Support ETA 7 business days. Included flagged parameter ratecard_id:null in payload.
liam_rev: I'll update the May close checklist to reflect revenue hold. Maria — please add a journal entry placeholder so month close doesn't post the $4,320.
maria_fin: done — JE placeholder: PLH-4721-COMMIT. Will monitor ticket and release hold when credit posts.
billing-bot: Reminder scheduled: revisit AZ-SUP-2026-9912 on 2026-05-12.
liam_rev: thanks team. Follow-up: if support requests evidence, attach commitment CR-221 and the partner's signed Addendum scanned PDF. I have it in Box (link masked). :thumbsup:
maria_fin: added link to box and to the reconciliation sheet. Closing loop here once credit posts.
